title: Record physical disposal
purpose: Record a completed, laboratory-authorized physical disposal and custody transfer while retaining all electronic records.
summary: Record that a sample was physically disposed of, with the laboratory's authorization. All electronic records stay.

tasks.title: Record the disposal
steps: Enter when it happened, the [[Disposal method]] and the [[Disposal destination]].
Enter who handed it over and who received it, and the [[Reason]].
Tick the confirmation and select [[Record physical disposal]].

tasks.title: Find out why disposal is refused
steps: Read the warning above the form. It names the reason, such as a hold or outstanding tests.

good_to_know: A retention date must be set and have passed, and no disposal hold or receipt Hold may be active.
Every requested test must be on an issued report, unless the sample was rejected.
Open preparation work must be closed or cancelled first.
After disposal, receipt, custody and storage can no longer change. Results and reports stay readable.
The confirmation records your statement. It does not make an ineligible sample eligible.

items.label: Physically disposed at
items.description: Completed action time, initially now, in laboratory local time. Cannot be future or earlier than the latest custody event. Its local date must be strictly after the inclusive retention-through date.

items.label: Disposal method
items.description: Required list: Select…, Returned to client, Neutralized and discharged to sanitary sewer, Hazardous waste contractor, Solid waste (non-hazardous), Consumed in analysis or Other…. Other… reveals a text box (Describe) whose text is stored, up to 160 characters. The choices are starter wording only; the application does not choose a disposal policy or confirm that a method is authorized.

items.label: Disposal destination
items.description: Required destination, up to 160 characters; becomes current location.

items.label: Relinquished by / Received by
items.description: Required actual custodians, each up to 160 characters; separate from the recording actor.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required explanation of the completed authorized action.

items.label: I confirm this records physical disposal and the laboratory authorized the action.
items.description: Required confirmation checkbox. It records the operator’s confirmation rather than authorizing an otherwise ineligible sample.

sections.title: Submission gates
paragraphs: An explicit retention date must exist and have elapsed before the disposal date. Both the separate disposal hold and receipt disposition Hold must be clear. Every requested test’s latest internal or active external result must belong to an issued report, unless the receipt disposition is Reject. Rejection bypasses the outstanding-test gate only; it does not bypass retention, holds, custody chronology or open preparation. Preparation work that still blocks disposal must be closed or cancelled first; its records remain. A corrected latest result reopens the issued-result requirement even when an older version was reported.

When disposal is certain to be refused whatever is entered, a warning above the form gives the reason when the page opens. These cases are: no retention date, a disposal or disposition hold, a retention date that is today or later, open preparation work, and outstanding requested tests. The form stays available. Saving is still checked by the server, and a refused save shows the reason once, as the form error.

items.label: Record physical disposal
items.description: Receipt roles save disposal actor/time/method/destination/reason, append custody and audit events, and update location together. Returns to storage. Afterward receipt/custody and storage mutations are blocked; electronic samples, analyses and reports remain readable.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to storage without recording disposal.

sections.title: Access and safeguards
paragraphs: Custodians, project managers and administrators can save. The header names the client and current location. A concurrent custody, retention or sample change is refused; submitted input remains on the error page. Reload and review current custody/retention before resubmitting. A disposed sample shows a retained-history notice instead of an editable form and rejects further changes.
